svg.title: All's Well: on a night-blue ground, the cream paper dial of a watchman's clock, ringed with 720 tiny embossed marks, one for every two minutes of a day. The marks are identical, but small gaps open just after several hour lines, and at one point a lone red pin marks a restart the dial never recorded. At right, a lantern-lit column of identical log lines reading "$ bash keepalive.sh", fading into the dark, under the words "All's Well".
